# Coordinates for the projection oracle: tools/csharp-reference/MpProjection.cs, regen-projection.sh.
# Directives are described at the top of MpProjection.cs. Every point is projected at every zoom
# and to UTM; every two consecutive points are also a pair for GetDistance/GetBearing/newpos.

# Global lattices. 15 degrees hits the poles, the equator, the prime meridian and both sides of the
# antimeridian exactly; 17.9 degrees from 89.5 south lands on nothing round.
lattice -90 90 -180 180 15
lattice -89.5 89.5 -179.5 179.5 17.9

# Survey scale: 0.01 degrees (about 1.1 km) around ArduPilot's SITL home at CMAC.
lattice -35.40 -35.33 149.12 149.19 0.01

# The Web Mercator clamps. GMap clips latitude to +-85.05112878 (MercatorProjection.cs:14-15); the
# projection's true edge, atan(sinh(pi)), is 85.0511287798066. Both, and either side of them.
point 85.05112878 0
point -85.05112878 0
point 85.0511287798066 10
point -85.0511287798066 -10
point 85.05112877 20
point -85.05112877 -20
point 85.05112879 30
point -85.05112879 -30
point 85.0511 45
point -85.0511 -45
point 85.1 60
point -85.1 -60
point 86 90
point -86 -90

# The poles' neighbourhoods, and UTM's own limits (84 north, 80 south).
point 90 0
point -90 0
point 89.9999999 45
point -89.9999999 -135
point 89 179.9
point -89 -179.9
point 90 180
point -90 -180
point 84 3
point -80 3

# The antimeridian.

point -16.5 -179.99999
point 65.5 180
point 65.5 -180
point 51.5 179.999999999

# Null Island, a nanodegree either side of it, and Greenwich.
point 0 0
point 0.000000001 0.000000001
point -0.000000001 -0.000000001
point 51.4779 -0.0015

# SITL home (ArduPilot's CMAC, -35.363261 149.165230) and the value the Rust tests use.
point -35.363261 149.165230
point -35.363262 149.165237

# A millimetre from SITL home: 1 mm north is 8.98e-9 degrees, 1 mm east at 35.36 S is 1.10e-8.
point -35.363261009 149.165230
point -35.363261 149.165230011
point -35.36326101 149.16523001
point -35.3632610001 149.1652300001

# newpos: millimetres to half the planet, across the antimeridian and the poles, and the bearings
# and distances nobody should pass but the C# accepts.
newpos -35.363261 149.165230 0 0.001
newpos -35.363261 149.165230 90 0.001
